name: RCC, Wilms Tumour and Urothelial Cancer

reference.source: Robbins Basic Pathology 9th Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
reference.pathophysiology: VHL loss stabilises HIF driving VEGF hypervascularity while WT1 loss freezes metanephric blastema into triphasic tumours; aromatic amines adduct urothelial DNA field cancerising the tract, and anaplastic p53 clones resist therapy.
additionalDifferentials: Clear cell versus chromophobe by vessels and prognosis
Wilms versus neuroblastoma by midline and catecholamines
CIS versus papillary by flatness and BCG response
additionalInvestigations: Triple phase kidney with chest staging in haematuria
Abdominal mass with WT workup and chest CT in toddlers
Cystoscopy with cytology in painless haematuria
